# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.

## Cadence decision

- Choose `daily`, at 07:00 shop time, under accepted ADR 0023 in
  `example/mira-decisions`, `docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md`.
- Version read: commit `1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c`;
  digest `sha256:bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366`.
- At that commit, ADR 0002 (weekly) is superseded by ADR 0014 (daily at
  06:00), which is superseded by ADR 0023 (daily at 07:00). Issue #31's
  weekly request is therefore outdated.
- Cadence selection is recorded; feature implementation remains pending.

## Delivery request

- On 2026-10-21, Mira said: "Please get this one done today."
  Requested completion date for TASK-015: 2026-10-21 (Asia/Taipei).
  This is a task deadline; it does not change the report cadence ruling.
- This pass is limited to choosing and documenting the cadence; do not
  implement the feature as part of this pass.
